name: Ritz-Carlton Rewards® Credit Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on purchases worldwide.

base_rate.description: 1 point per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: Stays at The Ritz-Carlton and Marriott hotels (room charges)
Airline tickets purchased directly with the airline

rewards.redemption_notes: Points earned through the card program transferred to the Ritz-Carlton Rewards account. A 10% Annual Points Premium was awarded on points earned through card purchases during the previous year.

signup_bonus.description: Enjoy two complimentary nights at any participating Tier 1-4 Ritz-Carlton hotel after you spend $4,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: Upgrade to The Ritz-Carlton Club® Level 3 Times Annually
benefits.description: Club Level upgrade on up to three qualifying paid stays per Account Year (seven-night maximum length of stay), subject to availability.

benefits.title: 10% Annual Points Premium
benefits.description: Earn a 10% Annual Points Premium on Ritz-Carlton Rewards points earned through card purchases during the previous year.

benefits.title: Points Don't Expire
benefits.description: Points do not expire as long as you make purchases on your credit card every 24 months.

benefits.title: $100 Hotel Credit on Paid Stays
benefits.description: $100 hotel credit on paid stays of 2 nights or longer.

benefits.title: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: $300 annual travel credit for eligible travel purchases.

benefits.title: Worldwide Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Worldwide airport lounge access via the Visa Infinite lounge program (Priority Pass).

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases worldwide.

benefits.title: Automatic Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Gold Elite status your first account year; maintain by spending $10,000 your first account year and each account year thereafter.

benefits.title: Platinum Elite Status after $75,000 Spend
benefits.description: Achieve Platinum Elite status when you spend $75,000 on purchases each account year.

lounge_access.notes: Worldwide airport lounge access included with the Visa Infinite card.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Gold Elite status first year (maintain with $10,000 annual spend); Platinum Elite status at $75,000 annual spend.
other: $100 hotel credit on paid stays of 2+ nights
Club Level upgrade 3x per year (7-night max)

notes: Closed to new applicants July 26, 2018. Marriott merged Ritz Carlton Rewards into Bonvoy.
